title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
**Ready to Help Shape the Future of Legal Tech?!**

At Litera, we don't just build software, we transform how the world's top law firms operate. Every day, we Raise The Bar™️ for what's possible through AI, innovation, and solutions that power millions of legal professionals worldwide. If you're energized by scale, real impact, and meaningful challenges, you'll feel right at home here.  



  

**Where You'll Work**

**Hybrid:** This is a hybrid role based in Ahmedabad with the expectations to be in office at least 3 days a week for collaboration and connection.  



  

**Why this Role Matters**
-------------------------

As a Senior Database Engineer, you'll be the driving force behind the performance, reliability, and scalability of the databases that power Litera's SaaS platform — used daily by millions of legal professionals worldwide. You'll partner closely with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to shape data architecture decisions that directly impact customer experience and platform uptime. This is a high\-visibility role where your expertise in PostgreSQL will influence how we build and scale our next generation of cloud\-native solutions. If you thrive on solving complex data challenges and want your work to have real, measurable impact, this is the opportunity for you.  



  

**What You'll Deliver**
-----------------------

* Ensure Litera's critical SaaS databases run at peak performance through expert\-level PostgreSQL tuning, monitoring, and optimization — directly improving platform reliability for millions of users.
* Design and implement database schemas and data ingest strategies that scale with our growing product portfolio and customer base.
* Drive root cause analysis during major incidents and lead cross\-functional resolution efforts, minimizing customer impact and strengthening system resilience.
* Implement advanced security standards — including row\-level security and data encryption — to protect sensitive legal data and maintain compliance.
* Architect backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions that ensure business continuity and give stakeholders confidence in our platform.
* Automate routine database operations to reduce toil, increase reliability, and free up engineering capacity for higher\-impact work.
* Review and improve database code across teams, mentoring engineers on best practices and elevating the quality of our data layer.

Stay ahead of emerging database technologies and practices, bringing forward recommendations that keep Litera at the cutting edge.  

* 

  

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

***Must\-Haves:***

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Database Administrator, with deep expertise in PostgreSQL (cloud and on\-premises).
* Proven ability to write, debug, and optimize complex database queries and code.
* Strong experience with cloud database solutions and infrastructure.
* Solid understanding of database engine tuning, partitioning strategies, and physical schema design from logical models.
* A problem\-solver who can reverse\-engineer issues, simplify complexity, and communicate clearly under pressure.
* Comfort with on\-call rotations and the ability to maintain composure during high\-urgency production incidents.

***Nice to Haves:***

* Experience with data modeling, master data management (MDM), or data dictionaries.
* Background working with SaaS products in highly regulated environments (SOX, HIPAA, PCI).
* Familiarity with software development practices and workflows.

Knowledge of security and privacy compliance frameworks.  

* 

  

*Great candidates don't check every box — if this role excites you and you bring most of what we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.*

  

**What You'll Experience**
--------------------------

* **A team that shows up.** Work alongside people who collaborate, support one another, and lead with integrity.
* **Global Reach.** Partner with teams around the world to solve complex challenges that matter.
* **Real opportunity for growth.** Expand your impact through meaningful stretch opportunities, visibility and career development.
* **AI\-driven innovation.** Work at the intersection of legal technology, customer outcomes, and cutting\-edge AI.

Litera is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Database Administrator (MySQL)
company: Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd
description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented **Database Administrator (MySQL)** with a minimum of **2 years of hands\-on experience**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing MySQL databases in both development and production environments. You will ensure high availability, performance, security, and reliability of all database systems while working closely with development and IT teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and maintain MySQL databases across development, testing, and production environments.
* Design and implement efficient database structures, data models, and schema changes.
* Monitor database performance and perform tuning of queries, indexes, and overall database architecture.
* Ensure high availability and reliability of databases with minimal downtime.
* Perform regular database backups, restores, and disaster recovery planning/testing.
* Manage database security, including user roles, permissions, and access control.
* Troubleshoot and resolve database\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Monitor database health, performance metrics, and capacity planning.
* Optimize slow queries and improve overall system efficiency.
* Support application teams with database\-related requirements and integrations.
* Maintain documentation for database configurations, processes, and changes.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Minimum **2 years of professional experience** as a MySQL Database Administrator.
* Strong expertise in MySQL architecture and administration.
* Excellent knowledge of SQL, stored procedures, views, triggers, and indexing.
* Hands\-on experience in performance tuning and query optimization.
* Solid understanding of backup, restore, replication, and migration processes.
* Experience with database monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of database security best practices.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, night\-shift production support environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with MySQL replication and clustering.
* Knowledge of high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) setups.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
* Basic scripting knowledge (Shell/Python) for automation tasks.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience
* Opportunity to work on production\-critical systems
* Learning and growth in scalable database environments
* Supportive and technical team environment

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Makarba, Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* MySQL: 1 year (Required)
* AWS: 1 year (Required)
* AWS CloudFormation: 1 year (Required)
* Google Cloud Platform: 1 year (Required)

Shift availability:

* Night Shift (Required)

Work Location: In person
